experiment_data.hypothesis: Learned representations (frozen LLM → MLP) 的 K* 是否高于 hand-crafted 15D features？若 K*_neural > K*_15D，说明 15D projection 是 K*=2 的部分原因；若相同，加强 information-theoretic impossibility 论证

spec.command: python scripts/run_exp015_neural_probe.py --device cuda:0 --embed_batch_size 16 --data_dir data_exp001_pythia data_exp002_olmo data_exp017_qwen_cont --label Pythia OLMo Qwen-cont

metrics.key_finding: Neural probe (frozen LLM hidden states → MLP) achieves K*=3 vs hand-crafted 15D features K*=2. 2v3 AUC=0.620 > θ=0.60, confirming richer representations can push K* higher. This validates K*_empirical=2 as an operational lower bound of the 15D feature set, not an information-theoretic limit.

experiment_data.notes: Completed successfully despite OOM during Qwen inference (exp-006 + exp-015 exceeded 24GB). Script had fallback path using precomputed embeddings. K*(neural)=3 > K*(lgbm)=2: 2v3 AUC=0.620 crosses θ=0.60 threshold. 3v4 AUC=0.593 < θ. Neural probe accuracy 43.35% vs OBD-LightGBM 38.6%. Exit via SIGHUP (code 129) after results saved. Results at artifacts/exp015_neural_probe_results.json.
